ratings_why.fun: Each tier does its job, and the late stacking of Maid, Old Crest and Hesketh is a spike worth climbing towards; the early turns are plain bodies.
ratings_why.distinct: The limp board and Curtain Call reveal are fresh, but the engine is a Deathrattle tribe with a Baron (Old Crest) and a Deathrattle-repeater capstone (Hesketh).

verdict_why: Copied Death Scenes can trigger each other forever, so the rules need one line before the tribe can be played.

points.text: Two Little Anguis beside Sir Hesketh both copy his scene, then each copy triggers the other forever (a Tail carrying it does the same). Add a rule: a Death Scene can't trigger itself, or any scene, twice in one chain.
The Brothers Berus with extra triggers (Maid, Old Crest) says 'the enemy across', but after the first destroy that slot is empty. Say whether later triggers fizzle or pick a new target.
Growth comes almost all from Tier 4 up; Turns 1-5 are bodies that refuse to die. A Tier 1 or 2 Death Scene that grows itself would give the opening a shape to build on.
Household Guardian is a flat 1 gold or a one-fight life each turn; a Saucer that also feeds Bufo or Wreath-Weaver when used would give it a build.
Coronella answers 'winning cleanly grows less'; a second Start of Combat knock-down at Tier 2 or 3 would let that build start earlier.

standouts.why: Coronella pays Death Scenes before the first attack, so the seating puzzle matters and a clean win still grows.
Little Anguis copying a neighbour's scene and leaving a Tail that carries it is the best seating card here.
Sir Hesketh is a real capstone: the comp is built to reach his fall.

weakest.why: Household Guardian is a light, generic economy piece at Tier 4.
Chorus Snake is a vanilla extra life with nothing to grow.
Born-in-the-Wings Hatchling only grows Attack and only when others play dead, so it stays small early.

flags.note: Copied Hesketh scenes on two Anguis or a Tail trigger each other with no end.
Hesketh with Old Crest and the Maid fires every scene 4-6 times, in the shop too via Prompt-Box Eft.
Dame Natrix goes down three or four times with Žilvinas, each a board-wide permanent buff that Old Crest and the Maid multiply.
Berus with Maid, Old Crest and Žilvinas can destroy most of an enemy board in one fight.
What extra triggers do once the enemy across is gone is not said.
